protocol.registration_scope: Written after native B0 seed 0/1 began, before aligned runs; not a prospective preregistration of the entire study
protocol.initialization: Astar native 2-relation initialization; copy all shared parameters and relation rows 0/1 into B0; restore post-Astar-init RNG before training
protocol.training_inputs: unchanged P1 spot scanpy Z ddof1, gene Z ddof0, Top-Z K20, paper-X KL, spatial tile plus one-hop halo; KL includes halo
protocol.clustering: P1 frozen Leiden target-K=5 resolution sweep 0.10..3.00 step0.05; closest K if no exact hit; no truth selection
protocol.primary_endpoint: rare binary F1 at truth <=5%, predicted cluster <=5%

null_tests.coordinate_permutation: frozen checkpoint full-graph inference with spot-coordinate association permuted, without changing expression or training batches
null_tests.degree_rewire: frozen checkpoint full-graph inference with undirected degree-preserving double-edge swaps, no self loops
null_tests.message_block_holdout: train a paired B0 with edges touching leftmost 20% coordinate-x spots removed; restore full spatial graph at eval; expression/Z and losses remain transductive, not an unseen-tissue benchmark

success_gate.paired_primary: all three rare-F1 differences >0 and mean > sample sd of Astar; also exceed empirical change from within-checkpoint relation-off diagnostic
success_gate.null: coordinate-permuted and rewired checkpoint inferences must not retain same primary improvement; diagnostic necessity evidence only, not retrained causal null
success_gate.geometry: no all-three decrease of effective rank with all-three increase of neighbour cosine; continuous values reported
success_gate.safety: no all-three decrease of boundary F1 or rare enrichment
success_gate.on_failure: do not advance to refinement; record no stable spatial benefit under tested protocol

limitations: Three seeds give descriptive variability, not population confidence
P1 native source/data/graph hashes and checkpoints were not recorded; regenerated Astar must match saved P1 embedding to validate replay
